name: CW Real Estate
summary: Audit for CW Real Estate: 5 potential operational gap(s) identified. Estimated annual opportunity NGN 516,530,000.

findings.impact: Sites scoring below 40 convert 18% fewer visitors into enquiries. With NGN 3,500 avg lead cost, every lost conversion is money left on the table.
findings.description: CW Real Estate's website scored 30/100. Website scored 30/100 in technical analysis. No modern framework detected. A low-scoring website loses visitors to competitors with better user experience and faster load times.
findings.estimateNote: Illustrative estimate — an approximation of the potential opportunity using the assumptions above, not a measured business result.
findings.recommendation: Optimize website for SEO, mobile responsiveness, page speed, and conversion rate. Add clear CTAs and contact methods.

findings.impact: 78% of leads prefer WhatsApp but cannot reach you that way. Each missed lead costs approximately NGN 3,500 to acquire through other channels.
findings.description: No WhatsApp Business integration detected on CW Real Estate's website. In Real Estate, 78% of customers prefer WhatsApp for business communication (Statista 2025). 39% of potential customers cannot reach you on their preferred channel.
findings.estimateNote: Illustrative estimate — an approximation of the potential opportunity using the assumptions above, not a measured business result.
findings.recommendation: Add WhatsApp Business API with instant auto-response. Customers who get a reply within 5 minutes are 21x more likely to convert (InsideSales.com).

findings.impact: 18% no-show rate means roughly 1 in 6 appointments is wasted. Staff spend 5+ hours/week coordinating schedules manually.
findings.description: No online booking system detected on CW Real Estate's website. Customers must call or message to schedule. Real Estate businesses without online booking experience 18% no-show rates, compared to under 5% with automated reminders (Calendly 2025).
findings.estimateNote: Illustrative estimate — an approximation of the potential opportunity using the assumptions above, not a measured business result.
findings.recommendation: Implement an online booking engine with automated WhatsApp and email reminders. Reduces no-shows by up to 40% and frees staff time.

findings.impact: 77% of leads do not receive consistent follow-up. Manual lead management in Real Estate costs an average of 15 hours/week in data entry alone.
findings.description: CW Real Estate has a website but no CRM integration detected (HubSpot, Salesforce, Pipedrive, Zoho). Without a CRM, leads from website forms are likely managed manually in spreadsheets or inboxes, leading to lost follow-ups and duplicate outreach.
findings.estimateNote: Illustrative estimate — an approximation of the potential opportunity using the assumptions above, not a measured business result.
findings.recommendation: Implement a CRM to capture, track, and automate lead management. Even a basic CRM reduces follow-up gaps by 50%+.

findings.impact: Average website converts 2-5% of visitors. Live chat increases this to 4-8%. For a site with 1,000 monthly visitors, that is 20-30 additional leads per month.
findings.description: No live chat or chatbot detected on CW Real Estate's website. 79% of consumers expect immediate responses to enquiries (Zendesk 2025). Without live chat, visitors who have questions leave without converting.
findings.estimateNote: Illustrative estimate — an approximation of the potential opportunity using the assumptions above, not a measured business result.
findings.recommendation: Add live chat or AI chatbot for instant visitor support. Even a basic chatbot captures after-hours enquiries.

tasks: Respond to property enquiries within 5 minutes
Run reactivation campaigns for old enquiries
